VERSION 3.27.3.0

; Writerdeck native sidebar entry for rM2 xochitl (XOVI + qt-resource-rebuilder).
; Learned from AppLoad's Sidebar.qml hook; no AppLoad runtime.
; Gate: only enable when IMG_VERSION is in tested-os.json (see scripts/enable.sh).

AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Sidebar.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0

    TRAVERSE DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler > ColumnLayout#filterColumn
        LOCATE AFTER DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler#integrationsHandler
        INSERT {
            SidebarFilterItem {
                id: openWriterdeck
                objectName: "openWriterdeck"
                title: qsTr("Writerdeck")
                iconSource: "qrc:/writerdeck/icon.png"
                active: false
                enabled: true
                Layout.preferredHeight: Values.navigatorSidebarItemHeight
                Layout.preferredWidth: parent.width
                navigationHandler: root

                CommandExecutor {
                    id: writerdeckCmd
                }

                onClicked: {
                    activate();
                    root.resetFocusIndex();
                    writerdeckCmd.executeCommand("/bin/sh", [
                        "/home/root/writerdeck-sidebar-launch.sh"
                    ]);
                }

                function activate() {
                    toggle();
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler#root
        REBUILD navigationModel
            LOCATE AFTER STREAM / integrations / INSERT STREAM / , openWriterdeck /
        END REBUILD
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
